mapper.sql: AND (p.owner_id = #{actorId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pm_project_member m JOIN pm_project_member_role mr ON mr.member_id = m.id AND mr.tenant_id = m.tenant_id JOIN pm_project_role r ON r.id = mr.role_id AND r.tenant_id = mr.tenant_id WHERE m.project_id = p.id AND m.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND m.user_id = #{actorId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.deleted = 0 AND r.project_id = p.id AND r.role_code = 'PM' AND r.deleted = 0))

WHERE l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND l.created_at >= #{start} AND l.created_at < #{endExclusive} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pm_project p WHERE p.id = l.project_id AND p.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND p.deleted = 0 ) AND l.project_id = #{projectId} AND l.module_code = #{moduleCode} AND l.operation_type = #{operationType} AND l.success = #{success} AND (l.operator_name LIKE #{keyword} OR l.operation_code LIKE #{keyword} OR l.request_path LIKE #{keyword} OR l.target_id LIKE #{keyword} OR l.project_name LIKE #{keyword})
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.operator_id, l.operator_name, l.operation_code, l.module_code, l.module_name, l.operation_type, l.target_type, l.target_id, l.project_id, l.project_name, l.request_method, l.request_path, l.success, l.http_status, l.duration_ms, l.error_message, l.client_ip, l.user_agent, l.changed_fields, l.trace_id, l.created_at FROM sys_operation_log l ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: WHERE l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND l.created_at >= #{start} AND l.created_at < #{endExclusive} AND l.success = #{success} AND (l.username LIKE #{keyword} OR l.client_ip LIKE #{keyword})
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.username, l.success, l.failure_reason, l.client_ip, l.user_agent, l.created_at FROM sys_login_log l ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT p.id, p.project_code, p.project_name FROM pm_project p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.project_name, p.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_project p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{actorId} AND ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.role_code = 'SUPER_ADMIN' AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0
SELECT id, project_name FROM pm_project WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{projectId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, project_name FROM pm_project WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project_code = #{projectCode} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_operation_log (id, tenant_id, operator_id, operator_name, operation_code, module_code, module_name, operation_type, target_type, target_id, project_id, project_name, request_method, request_path, success, http_status, duration_ms, error_message, client_ip, user_agent, changed_fields, trace_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{operationCode}, #{moduleCode}, #{moduleName}, #{operationType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{projectId}, #{projectName}, #{requestMethod}, #{requestPath}, #{success}, #{httpStatus}, #{durationMs}, #{errorMessage}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, #{changedFields}, #{traceId})
